name: contract-manager
description: Enterprise Contract & Procurement Ledger Desktop Application
author: Enterprise Contract Team

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const p=require('path');const pkg=require('./node_modules/electron/package.json');const bsDir=p.join(__dirname,'node_modules','better-sqlite3');const cmd='npx prebuild-install -r electron -t '+pkg.version;let ok=false;for(let i=1;i<=3;i++){try{execSync(cmd,{cwd:bsDir,stdio:'inherit'});ok=true;break;}catch(e){console.warn('prebuild-install retry '+i);}}if(!ok){execSync(cmd+' --mirror https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/better-sqlite3/',{cwd:bsDir,stdio:'inherit'});}"

nsis.shortcutName: 企业合同台账管理系统
